import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'C:/Users/agent/work/projects/stack/campaign')
import requests

# Scenario from the issue: remove a session default header by setting it to None
s = requests.Session()
s.headers['Accept-Encoding'] = None

# Path 1: plain request, no method-level headers
p = s.prepare_request(requests.Request(method='GET', url='http://example.com/'))
print('path1 (no method headers):', dict(p.headers))

# Path 2: method-level header override with None (documented, should already work)
p2 = s.prepare_request(requests.Request(method='GET', url='http://example.com/',
                                        headers={'User-Agent': None}))
print('path2 (method-level None):', dict(p2.headers))

# Path 3: s.request() entry point, like a real s.get()
class FakeAdapter:
    def send(self, request, **kw):
        return request
s2 = requests.Session()
s2.headers['Accept-Encoding'] = None
s2.mount('http://', FakeAdapter())
s2.mount('https://', FakeAdapter())
r = s2.get('http://example.com/')
print('path3 (s.get via request()):', dict(r.request.headers))

assert 'Accept-Encoding' not in p.headers, 'BUG: session-level None still present (path1)'
assert 'User-Agent' not in p2.headers, 'BUG: method-level None still present (path2)'
assert 'Accept-Encoding' not in r.request.headers, 'BUG: session-level None still present (path3)'
print('OK: None-valued headers are removed')
